lines.zh: 狂风卷起沙尘，我步步逼近！
lines.en: Dust stirs with the winds as I close in.

lines.zh: 灾祸之歌回荡在沙漠之中！
lines.en: The Song of Catastrophe echoes in the desert.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在沙地上留下痕迹！
lines.en: My claws leave marks in the sand.

lines.zh: 饥饿驱使我前进，无尽的战斗！
lines.en: Hunger drives me forward, endless battle.
The fall of the sanctuary drives me mad!

lines.zh: 猎物的味道在我鼻尖飘过！
lines.en: The scent of prey lingers in my nose.
Holy relics, I come for you!
Your downfall is in the making!

lines.zh: 刀刃拖在沙上，划出长痕。
lines.en: My blade drags through the sand, leaving a long line.

lines.zh: 我绕着圣所的断墙巡行。
lines.en: I pace around the broken walls of the sanctuary.
The end of the desert, my sanctuary.
This desert is my unending home!
I am the avatar of the storm!

lines.zh: 等待着我的，是无尽战斗！
祷词念完了，刀也出鞘了。
lines.en: The prayer is done, and the blade is out.

lines.zh: 祷词念到一半，我抬头了。
lines.en: Halfway through the prayer, I looked up.

lines.zh: 你的存在，就是我的猎物！
你在我注视下，无法隐藏！
lines.en: You cannot hide from my gaze!
Prey, I have you in sight!

lines.zh: 沙粒落定，我的刀已抬起。
lines.en: The sand settles; my blade is already up.
From behind the broken pillar, I fix on you.

lines.zh: 你以为躲在阴影里就看不见？
lines.en: You think hiding in shadow keeps you unseen?

lines.zh: 疯狂的刀锋在你身上留下伤痕。
lines.en: Mad blades cut into your flesh.

lines.zh: 我主的怒火烙印在你身上。
lines.en: My Lord's wrath burns upon you.

lines.zh: 诅咒从我爪中释放，侵蚀你的灵魂。
lines.en: Curse seeps from my claws, corrupting your soul.

lines.zh: 我的利爪撕裂了你的肉身。
深渊的寒意冻结你的血肉。
lines.en: The cold of the Abyss freezes your flesh.

lines.zh: 你身上的气息引来了我的注意。

lines.en: Feel the edge of my blade.
In the darkness, I found power.

lines.zh: 你的灵魂将加入我的祭坛。
lines.en: Your soul will join my altar.

lines.zh: 狂风将你卷入我的旋涡。
吞噬你的，是永恒的黑暗。
你阻止了我圣所的重建。
神圣朱砂，净化你的灵魂。

lines.en: Blood and flesh, for me to use.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲挡不住我的刀。
lines.en: Your armor can't stop my blade.

lines.zh: 你的骨头将做我的武器。
lines.en: Your bones will be my weapon.

lines.zh: 你将加入我的信徒行列。
神圣之吻，唤醒你的信仰。
我的力量将永远伴随你。
lines.en: My power will forever be with you.

lines.zh: 我的力量将使你无坚不摧。
lines.en: My strength will make you invincible.

lines.zh: 祷词念到一半，我抬头看你。
lines.en: Mid-prayer, I raise my eyes to you.

lines.zh: 拾起神圣朱砂，感受到它的力量！
lines.en: Pick up the holy sulfur and feel its power!

lines.zh: 吸取它的腐朽，净化你自己！

lines.en: Advanced experience bottle, are you worthy?

lines.zh: 远古枪零件，为你的武器！
lines.en: Ancient gun part, for your weapon!
Feel the rusted claws, so real!

lines.zh: 抓取投技，展示你的力量！
lines.en: Use grab throw, show your strength!

lines.zh: 神圣朱砂的光芒，指引你前进！
lines.en: Holy sulfur’s light, guide your path!

lines.zh: 金苹果的诱惑，难以抗拒！
lines.en: Golden apple’s诱惑, hard to resist!
Guardian of the sanctuary, here I come!
Corrupt your soul, I come for you!

lines.zh: 黄金苹果，吞噬你的渴望！

lines.en: Bottles of experience, are you worthy?

lines.zh: 神圣朱砂的光芒，指引我！
祷词停在半句，刀锋转向你。
lines.en: My prayer breaks off; the blade turns to you.

lines.zh: 祷词念完了，现在轮到你。
lines.en: The prayer is done, now it is your turn.

lines.zh: 圣所的沙地上多了你的脚印。
lines.en: Your footprints are new on the sanctuary sand.

lines.zh: 我的影子与你的影子重叠了。

lines.en: My rusted claws tighten and fix on you.

lines.zh: 该给祭坛添一份新鲜的供品。
lines.en: The altar is due a fresh offering.

lines.zh: 飞刀掠过，痛苦随之而来！
神圣朱砂，腐朽你的灵魂！
神圣朱砂的光芒，让你颤抖！
lines.en: Holy sulfur’s light, makes you tremble!
Corrupt your will, I come for you!

lines.zh: 金色的果实，吞噬你的灵魂！
祷词念到一半，我盯住你。
lines.en: Halfway through the prayer, I fix on you.
The blade turns half a circle in my palm.

lines.zh: 你背后就是圣所的断墙。
lines.en: The sanctuary's broken wall is at your back.
I have one more frenzy left in me.
There is the iron tang of cinnabar in the air.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的祷词越来越快。
lines.en: The prayer in my throat quickens.
You will tire first. I will not.
I have marked where you stand.
Dust cannot hide the gleam of my blade.
One step, two steps. Here I come.
I leap back and rake the sand wide!

lines.zh: 慢刀高举，落在你的颈上！
lines.en: The slow blade falls on your neck!
One stomp and gravel sprays your face!
Twin dashes, and the blade light returns!
I snatch you up and hurl you at the pillar!
Split daggers come from both sides!
Three dashes cut off every retreat!
Past half blood, I vanish and return at will!
The heavy slash lands and the sand erupts!
I chase you down and never stop!

lines.zh: 废墟里，祷词忽然有了声音。
lines.en: In the ruins, the prayer suddenly has a voice.

lines.zh: 圣所的沙从裂缝里流下。
lines.en: Sand runs down the sanctuary's cracks.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，祭坛还认得我。
lines.en: I open my eyes; the altar still knows me.

lines.zh: 教派已灭，只剩我还在念。
lines.en: The cult is gone; only I still recite.

lines.zh: 我的投掷武器命中你了！
